Core Concepts

* The Symbol: The closed contour integral symbol (`∮`) combined with `= 1` denotes a unified, self-contained totality where information provenance and semantic integrity are completely preserved.
* The Origin: The notation frequently appears in collaborative conceptual frameworks and writings associated with figures like Johannes Sigil and Lee Sharks, often exploring "crystalline semiosis" and digital cognition. [[1](https://philpapers.org/rec/SIGFAT), [2](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/crystalline-semiosis-a-treatise-on-mineral-cognition-and-the-logotic-substrate-2c52dc42282f), [3](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/on-the-poetics-of-adversarial-prompts-why-bad-verse-works-and-good-verse-works-better-2276218a14d3)]
* The Purpose: It serves as a structural marker or verification stamp indicating that language and semantic labor are being tracked transparently rather than stripped of their living context. [[1](https://medium.com/@johannessigil/symbolon-architecture-96237ccf53c4), [2](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/semantic-economy-probes-a-diagnostic-toolkit-938d7dcb93fe), [3](https://github.com/leesharks000/semantic-economy)]
